pages.scan: Opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/review/page-06.png with Read and looked at it. Four panels: two on the top row, a wide middle panel, a large bottom panel.
pages.observation: The page has no dialogue balloons, only captions and labels, so there are no tails to check. My reading order was: top-left 'Tomorrow, care may take us beyond our hometown.' (Ravi on a train, holding his phone), then top-right 'WELBUK VISION' and 'The vision: trusted connections between clinics, specialists, and patients across locations.' (an older doctor with grey hair and glasses), then middle 'WELBUK VISION' and 'One connected ecosystem for care and family wellness.' (Ravi, a woman and a boy with a tablet), then bottom-right 'Welbuk Practice • Welbuk Care • Welbuk Health', and last the bottom-left 'Welbuk — Building a connected healthcare ecosystem.'. Problems: (1) In the bottom panel the reading path jumps from the top-right label down to the bottom-left caption. That works, but the closing tagline in the lower-left also covers the receptionist's feet and the lower left edge of the doctor's legs. Those are not key props, but the overlap is noticeable on the final image. (2) The 'WELBUK VISION' label appears twice, in panels 2 and 3, which feels redundant. (3) The older doctor in panel 2 and the woman and boy in panel 3 have not appeared before and nothing introduces them, so a first reader cannot tell who they are or whether panel 3 is Ravi's family. Faces, hands, the tablet and the phone are not covered. I suggest considering a small move of the bottom-left caption and clarifying the new figures. Not a reading-order failure.
